005package org.wpilib.datalog;
006
007import java.util.Iterator;
008import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
009import java.util.Objects;
010import java.util.function.Consumer;
011
012/** DataLogReader iterator. */
013public class DataLogIterator implements Iterator<DataLogRecord> {
014  DataLogIterator(DataLogReader reader, int pos) {
015    m_reader = reader;
016    m_pos = pos;
017  }
018
019  @Override
020  public void forEachRemaining(Consumer<? super DataLogRecord> action) {
021    Objects.requireNonNull(action);
022    while (hasNext()) {
023      action.accept(next());
024    }
025  }
026
027  @Override
028  public boolean hasNext() {
029    if (m_next == null && !m_done) {
030      try {
031        m_next = m_reader.getRecordInfo(m_pos);
032      } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
033        m_done = true;
034      }
035    }
036    return m_next != null;
037  }
038
039  @Override
040  public DataLogRecord next() {
041    if (!hasNext()) {
042      throw new NoSuchElementException();
043    }
044    DataLogRecord record = m_next.record;
045    m_pos = m_next.nextPos;
046    m_next = null;
047    return record;
048  }
049
050  private final DataLogReader m_reader;
051  private int m_pos;
052  private DataLogReader.RecordInfo m_next;
053  private boolean m_done;
054}
